senses.gloss: pr. n. m.Ben Battiaḥ, nephew of R. Johanan b. Zaccai, one of the leaders of the terrorists during the siege of Jerusalem by the Romans.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:11:1">Koh. R. to VII, 11</cite>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:31">Lam. R. to I, 5</cite>; (<cite ref="Gittin 56a:15">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>אבא סקרא</he>).
